title: on the street - Back to His Roots
story:
Before the world knew him as j-hope, before the stages, the music shows, and the stadiums, there was a young boy in Gwangju who loved to dance. The streets and the dance community shaped his dreams, and hip-hop introduced him to the music that would eventually become his own.

A DREAM COME FULL CIRCLE

On **March 3, 2023**, j-hope released **"on the street (with J. Cole),"** a collaboration with one of his biggest musical inspirations. The song was more than a new single. It was a return to the roots of his artistic journey.

The connection between the two artists went back years. j-hope had admired J. Cole's music long before they met. In fact, **J. Cole was one of the artists who inspired him when he was discovering hip-hop and developing his own musical taste**. They finally met at **Lollapalooza in 2022**, where j-hope headlined the festival and J. Cole also performed. After that meeting, j-hope reached out to him because he wanted to make music together.

The result was a warm, laid-back lo-fi hip-hop track built around a melody and a whistle recorded by j-hope himself. He took part in writing and composing the song, while J. Cole contributed his own verse. Their collaboration brought together two artists whose journeys had been shaped by hip-hop and the streets.

THE MEANING OF ON THE STREET

But the title carries more than one meaning. According to BIGHIT MUSIC, **"on the street"** refers to j-hope's roots in street dance, where his dream of becoming an artist began. It also represents the path that he and his fans will continue to walk together.

The music video brings these ideas to life. j-hope walks through the streets of New York, dances in the subway, and moves through the city as if reconnecting with the places and feelings that first inspired him. Near the end, he meets J. Cole on a rooftop - a moment that turns a long-time dream into reality.

A SONG FOR HIS FANS

The song was also a heartfelt gift to his fans. Its lyrics express gratitude for the love and trust he has received, acknowledging that the support of his fans has become part of every step he takes.

In a **2023 interview**, j-hope explained that his roots in dance led him to music, and music eventually led him to rap. Looking back at the things that shaped him helped him find the direction for this song and for the next chapter of his life.

Sometimes moving forward means remembering where you started. And for j-hope, the street will always be part of his story.

A FAREWELL BEFORE HIS MILITARY SERVICE

The song also carried another, deeply personal meaning. Released just weeks before j-hope began his mandatory military service, **"on the street"** became a farewell gift to his fans before his temporary absence. Its message of gratitude, love, and walking the same path together made it an especially meaningful goodbye. Through this song, he left his fans with a reminder that even when they could not be together in person, their journeys would remain connected.
